root.label: NFL running backs receive record extensions

events.label: NFL running backs receive record extensions

slots.name: annual contract value
slots.sentence: The Detroit Lions’ Jahmyr Gibbs , Atlanta Falcons’ Bijan Robinson and Indianapolis Colts’ Jonathan Taylor , who play a position that’s been taken for granted – especially financially – in recent years, all signed deserved extensions that made them the first backs in NFL history with contracts that average at least $22 million in compensation annually.
